stories.title: England's first-ever T20 series win over India
stories.body: 4-0 (the opener at Chester-le-Street was washed out); India bowled out for 76 at Trent Bridge; final T20I at Southampton on 12 July.

one_liners: England's first-ever T20 series win over India — 4-0 (the opener at Chester-le-Street was washed out)
